GLYPH CHECK

Non breaking, zerowidth, softhyphen, “smart” ‘quotes’ — dashes – and…ellipsis.

Non-breaking hyphen, figure-dash, micro 5μm, fine ligature, check √ done, › pointer.

Emoji: 😀 ok, ❤ ok, 👍 toned, rocket, flag, family. Legend: (red) GOP, (blue) Dem.

Scripts: Café, Cu, Ελλάδα, Москва, 東京, [?], done.

Thanks to Jane Example for the tip.
